content.content: Immediate steps for a classic Williamson or Quick-Stop maneuver.

items: Spotter keeps eyes on person, pointing continuously
Execute recovery maneuver; approach from leeward at low speed
Secure recovery with a line/sling; treat for hypothermia/shock

content.content: Use your local MOB screen for drill mode if available.

sideB.content: Shout/Alarm, mark position (MOB on GPS), deploy flotation/marker.

content.content: Assess, alert crew, and attack safely from windward if possible.

items: Raise alarm; don PFDs; prepare VHF Ch 16 call
Isolate fuel/elec if safe; close hatches to starve oxygen
Use correct extinguisher class; short bursts, sweep base
If uncontrolled, issue Mayday; prepare to abandon to raft
